close_reason: Public-API change to ClientError::Parse / ClientError::Serialize variants (add context field). Variants are part of the locked SemVer surface; reshaping requires a major version. Deferred to 0.2.0 cleanup pass.
description: src/error.rs:32 (Parse) and :76 (Serialize) wrap serde_json::Error directly. When a caller sees ClientError::Parse, they know JSON parsing failed but not which response (fetch_session vs call vs upload_blob upload_resp vs SSE frame state-data). serde_json::Error gives line/column but no context within the response stream. Pattern fix: error variants with a context field — `Parse { context: &'static str, source: serde_json::Error }` where context is a static string like "session document", "JMAP method response", "BlobUploadResponse". The HTTP error similarly conflates connect/handshake/body-read into one variant. Idiomatic Rust libraries (e.g. reqwest itself) annotate context. Trade-off: changing the variant shape is breaking; could add a separate `#[non_exhaustive]` ParseContext enum and grow it in minor versions. Note: locked crate.
title: ClientError::Parse and ClientError::Serialize lose context on which call site failed
